crossRefs.note: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh…

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
translations.bsb: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh:
translations.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
translations.asv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half-tribe of Manasseh: and it was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
